name: muhkoo-app-builder
description: Describe an app idea in plain language and build it end-to-end on Muhkoo: provision the backend (app key, database tables, channels, agents, serverless functions), scaffold a Vite + React client against @muhkoo/connect, verify it with a live Cypress suite, give it a responsive distinctive design, and host it at <slug>.apps.muhkoo.dev.
